messages.subject: Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 61153167 error: Unhandled Exception: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'is_directed'
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I am very new using shiny, so I apologize in advance for my ignorance. I want to upload a really simple app to my shiniapps.io page for my collaborator to check the data easily. However, I can't seem to find a way to address this error message:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 61153167 error: Unhandled Exception: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'is_directed'

Any clues or advice are more than welcome. This is my entire code:

#install.packages('devtools')
#install.packages('shiny')
#install.packages('rmarkdown')
#devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

library(shinyapps)
library(d3heatmap)
library(shiny)
ui <- fluidPage(
  h1("Influenza Infection in NK Cells. RNA-Seq data"),
  selectInput("palette", "Palette", c("YlOrRd", "RdYlBu", "Greens", "Blues")),
  checkboxInput("cluster", "Apply clustering"),
  d3heatmapOutput("heatmap")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$heatmap <- renderD3heatmap({
    d3heatmap(
      scale(heatmap_matrix),
      colors = input$palette,
      dendrogram = if (input$cluster) "both" else "none"
    )
  })
}

app_shiny <- shinyApp(ui, server)
save(app_shiny,file="App_heatmap.html")

shinyapps::deployApp('App_heatmap.html')

Thank you so much!


Marta

Marta,

You should read the article on deploying single file apps here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/single-file.html specifically the first section:

To create a single-file app, create a new directory (for example, newdir/) and place a file called app.R in the directory. To run it, call runApp("newdir").

Then you can call deployApp:

deployApp("newdir/")

-Andy
